name: Can I prevent recurring drain clogs myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent recurring drain clogs myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some recurring clogs indicate structural issues requiring professional help, many can be minimized or prevented with consistent homeowner practices. Avoid pouring grease down drains, use drain screens to catch hair and food particles, and flush pipes regularly with hot water. For kitchen drains, occasional use of enzymatic drain cleaners (not chemical ones) can help break down organic matter. Professional drain cleaning every 1-2 years is also a good preventative measure.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can prevent many recurring clogs by avoiding grease, using drain screens, and flushing with hot water. Professional cleaning every 1-2 years also helps.
